resources.string: Instances is required. Reserved hours and region are optional: choose Supply to enter a value, or clear Supply to remove that field. No value is filled from the catalog.
Region is supplied exactly as entered, including empty text.
instances: a required whole number of instances, at least 1. This does not establish available capacity.
reserved_hours_per_month: an optional number of hours, at least 0. Zero is a supplied value. No calendar length, billing period or cost is inferred.
region: optional literal text. A supplied empty value, whitespace or the word unknown remains text; it does not verify a region or introduce an answer state.
Enter a supplied number, or clear Supply to leave this field absent.
Enter a JSON number using ASCII digits and a decimal point when needed.
Enter a whole JSON number using ASCII digits, without grouping or rounding.
Correct the invalid Unicode text before saving.
This value exceeds the existing local JSON input limit. Shorten it before saving.

Private pending-input recovery retains at most 20,000 characters across these controls (some symbols count as two). Larger input is replaced by an unavailable notice, without retaining a prefix. Recovery requires review and never repeats a save.
